nodes.label: Case Detail Modal - Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V. (ERP Contract Dispute)
nodes.description: UI screenshot of a case detail modal in the Captio legal case management application. The modal shows a case for 'Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.' under the category 'Negocios / contrato'. The case status workflow is displayed horizontally: Invitado, Nuevo, En revisión (currently active/highlighted), Consulta agendada, Revisión de conflicto, Cliente aceptado, Rechazado, Cerrado. Action buttons include 'Editar', 'Respuestas del cliente', 'Descargar HTML', and 'Eliminar'. The case details show: Fecha de ingesta (intake date not provided), Clasificación: Contrato de servicios — Incumplimiento y defectos en implementación de sistema ERP. A 'PUNTOS CLAVE' (key points) section lists: (1) ERP implementation contract for $1.8M MXN with NovaSoft Sistemas S.A. de C.V.; client paid $1.08M MXN advance in March 2024. (2) System delivered with 47 documented incidents, 12 still unresolved 5 months after deadline of Sep 30, 2024. (3) Quantified damages: $2.4M MXN in cancelled orders + $800k MXN in corporate client SLA penalties. (4) NovaSoft offers 20% discount on remaining balance; client refuses. Formal non-compliance notification: Dec 5, 2024. (5) Client seeks rescission, advance refund, lost profits compensation, and performance bond execution. (6) Main risk: possible counterclaim for 'change of requirements' and NovaSoft dissolution. A 'LÍNEA DE TIEMPO' (timeline) section shows a demo client entry created on 4/6/2026. A color picker overlay (resaltar/highlight tool) is visible. The modal demonstrates the case intake form, status tracking, key points extraction, and timeline features of the Captio platform.
